# HudSpec.DynamicDefaultRect property

When set, evaluated at mount/reset time to compute the spawn position, overriding [`DefaultRect`](./DefaultRect.md). Use with [`ScreenHeight`](../IFramework/ScreenHeight.md) to scale the initial position with screen resolution.

```csharp
public Func<WindowRect>? DynamicDefaultRect { get; set; }
```
